audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 4 read 'Urgot' in both layers while the packet level chart and the already-audited mirror both call them Skill. Worse, the full-layer why text on those same rows describes a Volibear win ('stun in, double-bite out', 'the start of your kill window', 'the strongest your lane will ever be'), so the side token and its own explanation disagreed.
audit.why: Level 2-3 is genuinely contested: Thundering Smash (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) plus Frenzied Maul (5s) give you a real short-trade pattern, but Purge (12/9/6/3/0s) and Echoing Flames shred straight back through it. Neither side wins outright. Level 5 is the same window before his ult and item spike, which content whys[4] already said.
audit.corrected: phases[1]/win[1], phases[2]/win[2] and phases[4]/win[4] set to Skill as one atomic group, ratings raised to 5/10, and the three whys rewritten so they no longer promise a kill window that is not there.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sold the level-6 dive with no mention of Fear Beyond Death, which is the single reason diving Urgot at low health is fatal.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death (100/85/70s, 2500 range) impales and executes below a health threshold. Stormbringer's tower disable does make the dive available, but it grants bonus health, not immunity — going in low means you die to the execute regardless of the disable.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now pairs the tower disable with the execute threshold and the 'never dive at low health' rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why said 'shield yourself as you disengage' without the condition that makes the shield exist, and named no cooldown for the stun.
audit.why: Sky Splitter (E, 16s, 1200 range) only shields Volibear if he is inside the blast radius — dropping it on Urgot from range gives slow and damage but no shield. Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1, so a missed charge leaves you flippable by Disdain (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) with no answer.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why now states the stand-in-the-blast condition and the 12s rank-1 stun cooldown.

audit.why: Both packet.suspectNames entries are FALSE POSITIVES. 'Fear Beyond Death' (spikes[1].text) and 'Corrosive Charge' (wants.foe[1]) are Urgot's real R and Q per the kit file; the flag fired on the leading words 'His' and 'Land'. Both left unchanged.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Urgot has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out, but Purge (12s at rank 1) shreds back through it, so keep every trade short.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Urgot under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you only if you stand in the blast — use it to leave Purge. Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1: miss it and you eat the flip.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Urgot under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer online — the tower disable makes a dive real, but Fear Beyond Death executes you below the threshold, so never dive at low health.

notes: Row 6 left untouched and raised as a question: this packet's levelChart says Volibear at 2+ items (and content whys[6] agrees), while the mirror audit reports setting row 6 to Urgot. I did not guess. Both packet suspectNames are false positives. Win rate here is 45.83% over 755 games, which sits oddly against diff 'EVEN' / difficulty 6/10 — also raised as a question rather than changed, because breakdown.difficulty and report[14] both hard-code 6/10 and flipping one without the others would put three different answers on the page.
